name: Tonbo Imaging India
summary: Bengaluru defence-electronics maker: thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, targeting and missile-seeker systems; ~71% of revenue from the Indian government.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹363 Cr (−23%), PAT ₹51 Cr (−30%); Q1 FY27 loss ₹17.7 Cr
positives: Owned, ITAR-free technology; #1 in Indian thermal imaging; ₹314 Cr order book
Defence theme; pre-IPO buyers include SBI MF, HDFC Life and 360 ONE
red_flags: Revenue and profit falling; operating cash flow negative two years running
Working-capital days 517; inventory tripled in two years
79x P/E on falling earnings; 100% OFS; promoters hold only 17%
anchor: Anchor bidding 14 Oct; allocation not public yet
